spec.name: Dutch Windmill
spec.description: A chunky Animal Crossing style Dutch windmill with a stone base, tapered brick tower, thatched cap, four lattice sails and a little gallery with a door, windows and a tail pole.
spec.layout: A static, rounded and toy-like windmill centred on x=0 and facing +Z. A wide octagonal stone plinth with a flower bed sits on the floor. Above it an octagonal tapering tower in cream plaster with warm wood trim rises to a gallery ring at y=1.3. The tower continues up to a red-brown domed cap with a small gable. A thick wooden axle (the windshaft) pokes out the front of the cap at +Z and carries four large sails in an X shape, each a wooden frame with cream cloth slats. At the back a tail pole with a small lantern leans down to the ground. The front has an arched door with steps and a lantern. Every surface is a flat colour in soft pastel, with chunky rounded forms, bevelled trim and little round windows. Style: Animal Crossing, with warm pastel colours, round friendly proportions, no sharp thin details, and slightly oversized door, windows and sails.

parts.builds: The ground-level base: an octagonal stone plinth (stone, with a stoneDark band), a grass pad with grassDark tufts, a curved path leading to the door steps, three wooden steps, and a flower bed with small pink, yellow and white flower parts, plus two round bushes. Chunky and rounded.
parts.attaches: Top at plinthTop; the tower starts there; the steps meet doorCenter.

parts.builds: The tapering octagonal tower from y=0.45 to 3.3: plaster walls with plasterShade panels and a brick lower course, wooden corner posts and horizontal trim bands, a wooden gallery ring with railing posts at galleryDeck, an arched door (wood with woodDark frame, round knob) at doorCenter with a hanging lantern (lanternGlow), round glass windows with wood frames on the sides and above the door, and a small hatch window on the back.
parts.attaches: Sits on plinthTop/towerBase; the cap sits on towerTop/capBase; the door meets doorCenter.

parts.builds: The domed cap: a roof-coloured lathe dome with a thatch band and roofDark ridge ribs, a small front gable with a round window, a wooden windshaft with a hub boss poking out the front to axleFront and hub, a rear tail pole going down and back from tailPoleRoot with a cross brace and a small lantern, and a small iron finial on top.
parts.attaches: Sits on capBase; the windshaft ends at hub, where the sails mount; the tail pole starts at tailPoleRoot.

parts.builds: Four big sails in an X, each 2.1m long, centred on hub at [0,3.7,1.5]: two woodLight stiles, wooden cross-rungs, and cloth slat panels on the trailing half, with a woodDark tip cap. Add a round hub cap (woodDark with a woodLight centre) at the hub. Rotate the pairs so they form a diagonal X, and add small cloth bunting flags at the sail tips. Sails sit flat in the XY plane at z=1.55 to 1.75, slightly staggered in z to avoid overlap.
parts.attaches: Centred on the hub mount at the end of the axle.
